name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: Settings reliability fix: Companion receivers no longer block Save just because they correctly have no remote address, and discovery skips Plex/Companion entries that do not speak the Jellyfin peer protocol. The settings page now turns JSON and plain-text server failures into concise messages instead of raw JSON or 'Unexpected token' errors. Storage cleanup also rejects a friend's item when that item is itself federated, preventing circular removal suggestions.
